instrumentation.description: Counters inserted in copies of generated C function entries and generic runtime read/write/request completion. Original generated C, driver and runtime are unchanged for baseline. Every native result byte is compared, including status, M/PS and all arena allocation words. Counter insertion can affect optimization/inlining; function counters describe semantic executions under this instrumentation, not machine call instructions.
instrumentation.diagnosticArrays: Host-only per-source-offset counters lie outside the arena and are not a memory-performance measurement.
instrumentation.lexicalOffsetDefinition: lexicalSpans.unique counts distinct start offsets, not distinct(handle,start,length) spans. lengthMismatch records repeated offsets with different lengths; histogram bucket64 means64or more. Do not infer a valid offset-only lexical cache or exact cache savings from this heatmap.

weightReuseProof.scope: Existing exact per-site operation counters are reused only after verifying its baseline generated C differs from the current C by the first66-to68 compiler-version banner alone. Its38site counts sum exactly to the newly instrumented current boot ap_read count.

interpretation.supported: Fixed128-word aggregate plumbing and tiny arena-row transactions deserve a general typed-IR demand analysis proof. Historical samples independently identify copy/zero work in several concrete callers; current exact structural counts establish the amount of page-valued source activity.
interpretation.notSupported: Semantic arena_zero calls and logical array capacities do not establish physical copy traffic, CPU percentages, potential speedup or the ability to close the full historical gap. The historical copy/zero sample share alone cannot explain a roughly sevenfold boot frontend gap. All protocol transactions remain a separate quantity.
interpretation.target: Effect-preserving interprocedural demand analysis and scalar replacement of private fixed aggregate results/continuations in typed SSA, before platform emission. Preserve original public signatures/value parameters and all effects; private projected results use scalar records and original array-index modulus, never a shortened array with changed semantics.
interpretation.firstProof: Conservative literal-field result demand through call/at/get, then rec/put and fold/loop continuation state. Unknown/dynamic/escaping demand retains the existing full value. Use one deterministic demand-joined private specialization per compatible context; measure compilation cost, emitted source/binary size and total package size. No shipping implementation has been started.
